items.how: The onepage agent replaced the [AI reading] tags with an italic line placed above What it is. That put a provenance qualifier before what the page is, the order Fable and astra had flagged and the first pass had undone. It also split the page's AI statement in two, where Ren's 8 November rule says it once. The line now sits inside the existing sentence: 'Made with AI, proofs included, and every reading here of what a law means for a case, a word or an actual system is AI's unless its home says otherwise; the proofs are checked by machine …'. The Chinese reads '它借助 AI 做成，证明也在内；本页的读法，即……连同表中的“例”，除非其所属之处另有说明，都出自 AI；……'. 'Made with AI, proofs included' and '借助 AI 做成，证明也在内' are kept verbatim, because spine.py quotes them. The English ten-minute part still computes to 9–12 minutes. The Chinese part computes to 11–15, and its stated time now says 约十一至十五分钟.

items.item: Fixed (medium), ONE-PAGE zh 证据; low in en: what the lock adds
items.how: The page copied the closed-capture record's phrase 'the exact condition (Unread) under which a loss leaves the lock'. In this repository 'leaves the lock' usually means exits it (ALIGNMENT A-10c, 07 D68). The Chinese, 损失离开锁定的确切条件, reads only that way. Unread is the exact condition under which a loss changes nothing in share or rule (courses_alike_iff_unread, an iff). A way out is only sufficient: 02 says of turned_by_loss 'a sufficient way out'. So the Chinese said more than the Lean proves. It now reads 'the exact condition under which a loss leaves the lock untouched' and 以及损失不触动锁定的确切条件.

What its makers want for alignment is now its own paragraph on the one page, '**Alignment.**', after the open question, in the same words the onepage agent wrote. It names condition 1 as AJ's plan restated it, and AJ's own note says no record shows you have read that restatement.
